reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited paragraphs support it: p0014 only imposes invoice supporting-detail obligations on Contractor (a right in our favour), and p0007's only access language requires Contractor personnel to comply with Company's system-access and security policies — neither creates any audit, inspection or verification right exercisable against the Customer.

With no audit right binding us, there is nothing exceeding the AUDIT limits on frequency, notice, cost allocation or system access; the absence of a redline and comment is the correct outcome, and inserting an audit framework would gratuitously create a right against us.

The failed deterministic check ('audit frequency limited') is a false signal here — the regex cannot match a frequency cap because the agreement contains no customer-facing audit clause at all; the unchanged redline text is consistent with a no-edit compliant finding.
